'''50R-T''', pronounced "'''Sortie'''," was a [[Tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] whose origins stretched back to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. Bearing a resemblance to [[Droid/Legends|droids]] of the [[GEMINI]] class, 50R-T eventually found herself as scrap on a battlefield. She would go on to be reprogrammed as a [[Dealer droid/Legends|croupier droid]] by new owners, who hoped that 50R-T's proclivity for tactics would give her an advantage in [[Gambling/Legends|gambling activities]].<ref name="Developer Insights" /> 50R-T wielded a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], as well as a deck of modified [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]] cards which she used to attack her enemies.<ref name="Kit Reveal">{{EA|subdomain=forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars|url=discussion/255967/kit-reveal-50r-t|text=Kit Reveal: 50R-T}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We've had the core idea behind 50R-T for quite some time and have been looking for a way to introduce her to Galaxy of Heroes and Star Wars as a whole|EA, on introducing 50R-T to Star Wars|<ref name="Developer Insights" />}}
50R-T was created as an original playable character for the [[Electronic Arts]] mobile game ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]''. Her creation came about after [[EA Capital Games]] collaborated with [[BioWare]] to add ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' villain [[Darth Malgus]] to the game. After seeing some of BioWare's ideas for a new droid character, the ''Galaxy of Heroes'' team worked with them and developed the idea into 50R-T. She was unveiled on [[May 11]], [[2022]] and became available in-game the [[May 12|following day]].<ref name="Developer Insights" />

The design for 50R-T was modeled after the [[Iokath]] droid models in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Developer Insights">{{EA|subdomain=forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars|url=discussion/255968/developer-insights-50r-t|text=Developer Insights: 50R-T}}</ref> specifically the [[PH4-LNX]] companion which shares a near-identical design with 50R-T.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Cheating Algorithm|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>
